plates.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a wide 3:2 scenic plate, 1536x1024, for Wonder Together, a refined caring family science book. Hand-rendered watercolor and fine graphite on warm ivory paper, quiet ink shadows, natural warm kitchen window light, restrained rare brass accent only on a magnifier. Canonical Big Wonderer and Little Wonderer are soft upright pebble-shaped creatures without clothes: Big warm gray about 1.5 times Little, Little warm cream, tiny dark dot eyes, tiny rounded ears, simple mitten hands and small rounded feet. No plush toy fur or bear muzzles. They stand or sit beside each other with a tender shared gaze toward the experiment. Cinematic composition, one clear focus, tactile wood, linen and paper. Quiet editorial mood compatible with Newsreader + Inter. NO text, typography, labels, arrows, border, panels or watermark. No outside pointing hand. Single scenic image, not a collage. Science should be visually coherent. A fresh golden rectangular cellulose kitchen sponge rests on a shallow wooden tray on a cozy kitchen table. Big steadies a brass-rim magnifier over the sponge; Little leans beside Big looking through it. Through the lens, several irregular pores in the sponge appear larger, connected open cavities rather than a grid of dots. Two clear cups, a shallow water dish, measuring spoon and linen notebook rest nearby. This image is also the new title-card illustration: spacious, calm framing and one compelling point of attention, the sponge holes.
